title: Driver Swap Tracer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Trace one call, move_to with shoulder_pan = 10 degrees, down through the layers of the arm library for three drivers: FakeArm, FeetechArm and DamiaoArm. Then choose what six calls do underneath. Used in Chapter 10.

educational.topic: The hardware abstraction layer: one Arm interface, three drivers
learningObjectives: Interpret what a call on the Arm interface does underneath for each of three drivers, in six calls, by choosing the correct low-level action, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Show one high-level call and ask for its low-level translation, so the learner traces through the layers and the unit conversions
keyQuestions: Which layer does this work: the base class or the driver?
What unit does this arm use underneath, and what message carries it?
commonMisconceptions: The same call sends the same bytes on every arm
The limit check is done by the driver
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed choices from six low-level actions, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: a / b / c / d / e / f (the six actions)
